Hidden Vegan & Macrobiotic Gem in Da Nang – Affordable, Nourishing, and Full of Life
Mar 2026 • Solo
If you’re searching for a truly healthy, vegan, macrobiotic restaurant in Da Nang, Anh Minh Thực Dưỡng is an absolute standout.

Located at 129 Xuân Diệu in the Hải Châu area, this small, welcoming spot delivers fresh, plant-based food that is both nourishing and incredibly affordable. I found myself eating here almost every day while staying nearby — it quickly became a staple.

Everything on the menu appears to be fully plant-based (no meat, no dairy) and centered around clean, wholesome ingredients. The smoothies are a highlight — especially with additions like spirulina, oats, peanut butter, and fresh fruits. They’re not just refreshing, they genuinely give you energy and leave you feeling strong and balanced.

The food is equally impressive. Generous portions at a very low price point, with dishes that are hearty, flavorful, and thoughtfully prepared. From warming soups to nutrient-rich bowls, everything feels intentional and satisfying without being heavy.

What truly makes this place special is the hospitality. The hosts are warm, kind, and genuinely welcoming. They’re happy to offer recommendations, but there’s no pressure — just a sincere desire to make sure you enjoy your meal. You feel at home here.

The atmosphere is simple, cool, and relaxing — a perfect escape from the Da Nang heat. There’s a quiet, positive energy in the space, with smiling staff and content guests enjoying clean, healthy food.

For anyone focused on vegan eating, macrobiotic nutrition, or simply affordable, high-quality meals, this place is a must-visit.

Highest recommendation. One of the best plant-based spots in Da Nang.
